findings.title: Hardcoded live API key shipped in client bundle
User-generated review body (and translation) rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, enabling XSS
useEffect omits productId from dependency array; reviews do not reload when the product changes
N+1 sequential author fetches inside a loop; waterfall of requests, one per review
No res.ok check or try/catch/finally in load(); a failed request leaves the component stuck on loading with an unhandled rejection and no error UI
Effect has no cleanup or AbortController; stale responses can overwrite state after unmount or prop change (race condition)
Clickable div used as a button: not focusable, no keyboard activation, no role
Leftover console.log dumping loaded review and author data
Translations cached by review id only; changing targetLanguage keeps showing the translation in the old language
API responses are cast with 'as' instead of being validated at runtime
